subject: Better messages when valkey-cli cluster --fix meet value check failed (#867)
reason: The diff changes only src/valkey-cli.c, inside the cluster manager's BUSYKEY value check: when `valkey-cli --cluster fix` (or reshard/rebalance) retries a MIGRATE that failed with BUSYKEY, clusterManagerCompareKeysValues now captures the DEBUG DIGEST-VALUE error reply and prints a clearer hint ('DEBUG command is not allowed... turn on enable-debug-command' or 'DEBUG DIGEST-VALUE command is not supported... use --cluster-replace'), and a connection error during that check now prints a message and exit(1) instead of silently failing. No server behaviour changes, so no compared command sequence o
